senses.gloss:
√smi (smáyate; siṣmiyé; ásmayiṣṭa;
smitá; smitvā́; -smítya). smile; smile
bashfully; blush. [cf. φιλο-μμειδής, ‘fond
of smiles,’ stem σμειδες, as in Hesychian
μεῖδος, ‘smile’; μειδάω, ‘smile’; Lat.
mī-ru-s, ‘wonderful,’ mīrāri, ‘wonder’ (for
mg, cf. smaya, ‘wonder’); Middle High
Ger. smie-r-en, smie-l-en, ‘smile’; Eng.
smile, smirk.]
+ vi, be astonished.

smita, a. smiling; as n. [1176a], a smile.
[ppl. of √smi.]

smita-pūrva, a. previously smiling,
with a smile. [for irreg. order, see
1291.]
